label: Event causation, entity feedback, simultaneity and sustaining priority
term: event causation, entity feedback, simultaneity and sustaining priority
resolution: The clock map refers to selected exercise instants of particular tokens, not the existence-time of their bearers or completion of the whole cause process. A₀→B₁→A₂ is feedback between beings but no event cycle. NoBackward permits simultaneous circles; StrictForward excludes finite event cycles but permits infinite upstream descent. Sustaining is a separate relation whose mathematical control has the same extension as the simultaneous circle only by stipulation. A common linear clock and the canonical motion projection are open interpretation choices. Passage, presentism/eternalism, actual realization, source fidelity and explanatory sufficiency are not decided.
